what: Hovering a pill button slides an accent-color film in from outside the right to its place in .3s, deepening as it goes (transparent to opaque), and the arrow circle grows to 1.1x. On release it leaves the same way to the right and fades — a button covered by a film while the panel background stays as is

options.[data-fx-part=icon]: (If any) Arrow circle — grows by the same length

use: Learn more — White button: style="--fx-fill: var(--kf-ink)"
note: The curtain is the element’s own ::after (z-index -1, isolation). For a button that already uses ::after, attach it to the inner span. The text color is changed by the consumer with :hover (the navy-purple button keeps its white text)

from.where: shared.css .mg-btn (navy-violet pill — orange curtain .3s ease · circle 1.1) · white button (navy-violet curtain) · header ‹Recruitment details› (dark orange curtain) — original .c-button::after·.l-header__button::after
